name: TextureCraft (open-source 3D texture painting, pure Rust)
summary: Free, open-source 3D texture painting app from the ArtCraft team: paint PBR materials onto models in layers with masks and generators, bake AO/curvature/thickness on the GPU, smart materials, UDIM, 8K texture sets, and export presets for any engine. Runs on macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD and in the browser; every tool is also a command (CLI, JSON channel, MCP server) so agents can paint, bake and export.

access.notes: Dual-licensed MIT or Apache-2.0 at your option (LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE, NOTICE); bundled assets listed in ATTRIBUTION.md. In active development (v0.3.0, 2026-11-03).

procedure: Open getartcraft.com/apps/texturecraft and download the ArtCraft Launcher (recommended), or grab a TextureCraft build directly from GitHub Releases (Windows MSI/portable, macOS, Linux AppImage/rpm/flatpak, FreeBSD).
Verify the download against SHA256SUMS.txt in the release if you want.
Import a mesh (glTF, FBX, USD, OBJ...), bake mesh maps, paint layers, and export textures with an engine preset.

verdict.why: Real downloadable, permissively licensed Substance Painter-style texture painter with GPU baking and an MCP/CLI surface; still early (v0.3) and young repo, so expect rough edges.
